preserve.tags: same composition, same placement and scale of every element, same camera angle, same framing, restyle only
preserve.prose: Restyle the supplied image. Keep the composition exactly as it is: the placement and scale of every element, the camera angle, the perspective and the framing. Do not add, remove or move anything, and do not crop or extend the frame. Change only how it is rendered, as follows.

tags.transform: transparent glass surface, caustic light patterns, refracted light rays, soft highlights, dappled light through glass, clean minimal background
tags.negative: opaque surface, flat lighting, matte finish

prose.transform: Make every surface read as transparent glass, lit from behind: caustic patterns of light thrown across the forms, rays visibly bending as they refract, soft specular highlights on each edge, and dappled light falling through the glass onto a clean, plain ground.
